about.title: About the game
about.content:
GOOFY AHH BATTLEGROUND is an anime-inspired battleground on Roblox, made by two beginner developers learning as they build.
Choose a fighter, learn their moves and face other players in the arena. Each character has signature abilities and an awakened form, with costumes to personalize their look.
Play on Roblox →
About this wiki
This is the game’s player guide. It covers the seven documented playable fighters, controls, combat, awakenings and costumes. Balance and available content may change during development; the in-game move bar and shop show the latest values.
Character names and references belong to their respective owners. This is a fan-made Roblox experience.

characters/dio.title: DIO
characters/dio.content:
In-game name: Vampire Lord · Awakening: Greatest High
DIO fights with The World, mixing a close-range barrage, a counter and time stop. Greatest High swaps his main kit for kicks, draining attacks and Road Roller.

During your own time stop, this becomes Knife Throw.3Stingy Eyes11sFire a ranged eye attack.4Freezing Grip26sCatch an opponent with a lunge to trigger a freezing sequence.R — tap / holdZA WARUDO24s / 45sTap for a quick stop or charge a longer time stop.EMenacing Pose—Toggle DIO’s pose with The World.

characters/gojo.title: Gojo
characters/gojo.content:
In-game name: Blindfold Sorcerer · Awakening: The Honored One
Gojo controls spacing with Blue’s pull and Red’s push. His defensive Infinity requires a held input. Awakening reveals a stronger kit and Unlimited Void.
Base moves

The Honored One









































InputMoveCooldownHow it works1Max Blue14sCreate a large pulling vortex.2Max Red14sRelease a stronger repelling blast.3Black Flash16sCatch a target for a sequence of four Black Flashes.4Purple 200%34sUnleash an amplified Purple.RUnlimited Void40sExpand a domain that traps and temporarily paralyzes opponents.
Playing Gojo
Use pulls and pushes to create an opening for a rush. Infinity is a deliberate defensive action, so release it when you are ready to attack again. After awakening, R becomes your domain.

characters/goku.title: Goku
characters/goku.content:
In-game name: Earth Saiyan · Awakening: Super Saiyan
Goku combines ranged ki attacks with mobility. In base form he can fly; after awakening, he gains close-range cinematic attacks and Kaioken.

Use C to descend during flight.
Super Saiyan
Fill your meter and press G to awaken.









































InputMoveCooldownHow it works1Instant Kamehameha14sCharge, teleport behind your target and fire at close range.2Meteor Smash16sCatch an opponent with a rush to start a chained combo and slam.3Ki Barrage10sPressure your opponent with ki blasts.4Farewell Blast30sUnleash a powerful one-handed ki wave.RKaioken24sTemporarily boost damage, movement and cooldown recovery at a health cost.
Playing Goku

characters/itadori.content:
In-game name: Cursed Vessel · Awakening: King of Curses (Sukuna)
Itadori focuses on close-range attacks and Black Flash timing. His awakening lets Sukuna take over, replacing his kit with slashes, Fuga and a domain.

Black Flash timing

characters/vegeta.content:
In-game name: Saiyan Prince · Awakening: Super Saiyan
Vegeta pressures opponents with beams and energy blasts. Explosive Wave gives his base form an escape from a combo; his awakened form trades that utility for Majin.
Base moves















































InputMoveCooldownHow it works1Galick Gun12sHold to charge an energy beam.2Big Bang Attack12sLaunch an explosive energy blast.3Energy Barrage11sFire repeated ki attacks.4Final Flash30sCommit to Vegeta’s signature beam.RExplosive Wave22sRelease energy around you; usable even while stunned.E — holdKi Charge—Recover health while charging in place.
Super Saiyan









































InputMoveCooldownHow it works1Galick Gun12sCharge an empowered beam.2Prince’s Fury16sCatch a target with a rush, then finish the combo with a close-range Big Bang.3Energy Barrage11sKeep pressure with energy blasts.4Final Flash30sLand a cinematic version of Vegeta’s signature attack.RMajin24sTemporarily boost damage and speed while draining your own health.

cosmetics.title: Costumes & coins
cosmetics.content:
Costumes let you change a fighter’s appearance while keeping their identity and moveset. Alternate outfits include changes to clothing and accessories. Some also change visual effects.
Available costumes
The default costume is included with each fighter.













































FighterDefaultAlternate costumesGokuClassicYardrat · End of ZVegetaClassicScouter · GTDIOClassicVampire (Part 1) · Shadow · Over HeavenJotaroStardust CrusadersDiamond is Unbreakable · Stone OceanTanjiroClassicFinal Selection · JourneyGojoThe StrongestHidden Inventory · ShinjukuItadoriVesselCulling Game
Coins
Earn coins through combat rewards and use them to unlock alternate costumes in the game’s skin selection. Check the in-game shop for the current price and ownership status.
Do costumes change power?
Costumes are cosmetic. They do not grant an extra combat kit. Awakening still follows the selected fighter: Itadori becomes Sukuna, for example, even when wearing Culling Game.
See Awakenings for the forms that do change your abilities.

guides/awakenings.title: Awakenings
guides/awakenings.content:
Fight to fill the awakening meter, then press G when it is ready. Awakening is temporary and gives your fighter an empowered kit. Check your move bar after transforming: abilities and the R utility can change.













































FighterAwakened formWhat changesGokuSuper SaiyanInstant Kamehameha, Meteor Smash, Farewell Blast and KaiokenVegetaSuper SaiyanPrince’s Fury and the Majin utilityDIOGreatest HighKicks, Piercing Fist, Blood Drain and Road RollerJotaroYou Pissed Me OffStopped-Time ORA, Bearing Shot, Platinum Counter and Three-Page ORATanjiroHinokami KaguraWater techniques become a fire-based sword kitGojoThe Honored OneMaximum techniques, Black Flash, Purple 200% and Unlimited VoidItadoriKing of CursesSukuna takes over with slashes, Fuga and Malevolent Shrine
Utility changes matter
Goku trades flight for Kaioken. Vegeta trades Explosive Wave for Majin. Gojo and Sukuna gain a domain. DIO and Jotaro keep time stop with stronger awakened limits.
Kaioken and Majin cost health while active. Pick a moment when you can use the extra pressure.
Awakening versus costume
An awakening changes your combat abilities. A costume changes your appearance. Buying an outfit does not unlock an extra moveset.

guides/combat.title: Combat basics
guides/combat.content:
Basic attacks and combos
Use basic attacks to create an opening, then connect a special move. Longer combos deal reduced damage, so an extended sequence is not always the best use of your cooldowns.
Some moves need to catch a target at close range. A frontal guard or a perfectly timed parry can stop an attempted rush. Positioning matters even when a move looks cinematic.
Blocking and guard breaks
Hold F to guard against attacks from the front. Blocking drains your guard when you are hit. Give the guard time to recover between exchanges; heavy attacks can break it.
Turn toward an incoming opponent. Holding block while an enemy reaches your back is not a complete defense.
Perfect parry
Press block just before an attack lands. A successful close-range perfect parry briefly stuns the attacker and gives you an opening. Parrying a distant attack does not stun a faraway opponent in the same way.
Dashes and recovery
Q dashes in your movement direction. Side dashes help evade an attack line; forward dashes help close distance. Dashes have a cooldown, so save an escape when an opponent still has moves ready.
While knocked down, use Q for a dodge roll. Getting up also has a brief protection window. After a stun ends, you can move, block or dash before you can attack again.
Lock-on
Press Left Alt to lock onto a target. Lock-on helps keep a nearby opponent in view; without it, aim your attacks manually. Distance, losing sight of the target or a defeat can break the lock.
Awakenings
Combat fills your awakening meter. A full meter unlocks G. Plan your transformation around an opportunity to use its kit, rather than activating it while every opponent is far away. Read Awakenings.

guides/controls.title: Controls
guides/controls.content:
Keyboard & mouse defaults





























































InputActionWASDMoveLeft mouse buttonBasic combo attackRight mouse buttonHeavy attackFBlock; time the press for a perfect parryQDash; dodge roll while knocked downLeft CtrlToggle sprintSpaceJump; press again in the air for a double jump1, 2, 3, 4Main movesRUtility abilityGAwakening, when the meter is fullECharacter-specific pose, charge or defensive abilityLeft AltLock on to a targetCDescend during Goku’s flight
Use a single right-click for a heavy attack while shift lock or lock-on is active.
Holds and follow-ups
The move bar shows your current abilities and cooldowns. A hold input is not always the same as a tap: beams can charge, Itadori can time a Black Flash release, and DIO/Jotaro can charge their time stop. Tanjiro can press some moves again to follow up.
Rebinding
Open Settings to change action bindings. If a key is already assigned, the two actions swap. The tables in this wiki use the defaults, so match them to your own settings if you change them.
Touch devices
Use the combat buttons on the HUD. The character kits are the same; keyboard letters in this wiki identify the corresponding action.

guides/getting-started.title: Getting started
guides/getting-started.content:
Your first fight

Join GOOFY AHH BATTLEGROUND on Roblox and press Play.
Pick a fighter. Start by learning one kit rather than switching after every fight.
Practice your basic combo, F to block and Q to dash. These matter just as much as your special moves.
Try each ability separately. Some inputs can be held, and Tanjiro has follow-up attacks on a second press.
Build your awakening meter in combat. When it is full, press G to activate your awakened form.

A useful first habit
Land a few basic attacks before trying a special move. Watch what the opponent does after recovering: blocking, dashing and attacking all need different responses. Avoid spending every cooldown at once.
Heavy attacks can break a guard. A well-timed block can parry an incoming attack. Read Combat basics before relying only on rush attacks.
Make the controls yours
The defaults are listed in Controls. You can rebind actions in Settings. On touch devices, use the on-screen combat buttons.
What to explore next

Awakenings for transformed kits.
Time stop & domains for special arena abilities.
Costumes & coins for cosmetic progression.

guides/time-stop-and-domains.title: Time stop & domains
guides/time-stop-and-domains.content:
These signature abilities use R. They have limited ranges and cooldowns, so positioning before activation matters.
DIO — ZA WARUDO
DIO can tap R for a quick time stop or hold it to charge a longer stop. His awakened form improves its duration and reach.
During his own time stop, his base 2 becomes a knife throw instead of the normal counter. Use the frozen opening to set up pressure.
Jotaro — Star Platinum: The World
Jotaro also has tap and charged time stops. A charged stop gives more time but requires a commitment to the charge. His awakening improves the ability.
Gojo — Unlimited Void
In Gojo’s awakened form, R opens Unlimited Void. Captured opponents are paralyzed for part of the domain and cannot leave its boundary while it holds. Gojo can move through the boundary.
Sukuna — Malevolent Shrine
After Itadori awakens into Sukuna, R creates Malevolent Shrine. Opponents caught inside face repeated slashes within the domain’s enclosed arena.


                  
                  Watch the state of the fight 
                  
                

Your normal R ability can change after awakening. Read the move bar before pressing it, and keep track of who is already caught in another ability.
